summary: Iteration 3 (WebAuthn/PIN, forgot-reset, admin master gate + merchants management) — backend: 21/21 pytest passed; frontend: all critical flows verified via Playwright. Backend covers PIN set/login (incl. 422 non-numeric + wrong-length, 401 wrong pin), WebAuthn register/begin (returns options with challenge/rp/user.name) and login/begin without creds (400 'Nessun dispositivo biometrico registrato'), password recovery (forgot returns reset_token for known email + generic response for unknown, reset with invalid token 400 / short pw 422, full reset flow updates password), admin master gate (wrong pw 401, non-admin 403, stats without master 403, stats with X-Admin-Master 200, /admin/session), and admin merchants CRUD + admin discounts update/delete. Frontend: /login shows Face ID big button + PIN fallback + Usa email/password + Registrati + Password dimenticata; admin login → /admin gated by master password (RomaMaster2026!) → dashboard with KPI cards (Clienti/Commercianti/Abbonati attivi/MRR) + Analytics/Negozi/Log tabs. Merchants tab: 9 approve toggles, 9 edit icons, 9 delete icons; edit reveals Salva/Annulla; delete triggers confirm(). /forgot-password shows reset link with token inline. /setup-security exposes pin-new, pin-confirm, pin-save, enroll-biometric-btn and PIN save works. Register flow with new email redirects to /setup-security.

(Security review, carried over from iter2) /api/payments/status/{session_id} still has no auth — any user knowing a session_id can trigger Stripe retrieve+mark_subscription_paid for another user. Not related to iter3 but still open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1300 lines; split into routers (auth, webauthn, admin, discounts, subscription, payments, redemptions) before next iteration.
ADMIN_MASTER_PASSWORD is compared with plain '==' (no HMAC compare_digest); low risk since single fixed string but consider hmac.compare_digest for constant-time.

/auth/forgot returns reset_token in the response body (MVP mode) — acceptable for demo but must be replaced by email delivery before production; add a config flag (e.g. FORGOT_RETURN_TOKEN=false) to hide it in prod.

PIN model uses Field(min_length=4, max_length=4) but does not enforce digits at Pydantic layer — handler raises 422 manually. Consider a pattern='^[0-9]{4}$' validator so schema-level clients get proper validation.

/admin/merchants returns 'approved: True' default for legacy merchants without the field — good; ensure new merchants get an explicit approved=false at register if a review-flow is desired (currently all new merchants immediately visible in listings).

webauthn_register_begin does not delete previous outstanding challenges for the same user; a stray challenge doc could linger until TTL expires. Consider deleting existing 'register' challenges before inserting new one.
AdminMasterVerifyIn.password is not rate-limited — brute force protection missing on /admin/verify-master. Add a per-admin lockout / delay after N failures.
